national.title: Megawati: Jadi Presiden Itu Gampang, Tapi Jadi Pemimpin Itu Sulit

international.title: An elevator, a brick wall and a bathroom: scientists use gravity to send ‘practically unblockable’ message
international.summary: Australian physicists chose to transmit the word ‘gravity’ in binary code through brick wall Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australian scientists have used gravity as a means of communication, in a proof-of-concept experiment involving a snail-paced 1950s elevator, a brick wall and a men’s bathroom. Physicists at the University of Queensland have used gravity to transmit a “practically unblockable” message about 70cm through a brick wall, by sending an elevator up and down between two floors and measuring changes in the gravitational field as a result of the movement.
